testcase.system-out: Scenario: Modify an existing feature and accept the updated preview ✔> Given a disposable copy of the native fixture "fixtures/cad/extrusion/extrusion-rect-8mm.opd" is open in the part modeling workspace ✔> And the viewport pointer is idle ✔ Given the fixture contains its accepted 8 mm extrusion ✔ When the user opens that extrusion for modification ✔ Then its current selection and parameters are displayed ✔ When the user changes its extrusion distance from 8 mm to 6 mm ✔ Then the preview reflects the pending modification ✔ When the user confirms the modification ✔ Then the existing extrusion remains in the model browser ✔ And the updated result appears in the viewport
